mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm really glad you're here with me. Have you ever felt like the world just slips a little too far from kindness, or that life’s challenges slowly build walls around your heart? Together, let’s explore how love, at its core, isn’t just a feeling—it's a healing force and a guiding light. That’s the heart of what Marianne Williamson shares in her book, A Return to Love: Reflections on the Principles of A Course in Miracles. She gently invites us to shift our perspective—from fear to love—and reminds us that compassion, forgiveness, and acceptance are choices we can make, moment by moment. What if, instead of searching for love outside ourselves, we remembered that love is already within us—just waiting to be rediscovered? When we open our minds to the idea that miracles are simply expressions of love, everything starts to change. Old hurts begin to fade, peace takes root, and even our relationships and sense of self-worth can transform in ways we never imagined. The wisdom woven through Williamson’s reflections offers a path to real inner freedom, where the ordinary moments of life become extraordinary, just by choosing to return to love. So, as we set out on this journey together, let’s stay curious and open-hearted. Healing and transformation aren’t distant dreams—they’re possibilities we can reach for, right here, in every thought and every connection we make.
